result.explanation: Maintain an ordered resident cache, durable map, lifetime versions, and per-entry flush eligibility. Writes advance versions; acknowledgments persist only the exact currently flushed version.
result.mapping: Cache entries map keys to value, version, dirty, and flushed state; order is oldest-to-newest. Durable stores acknowledged values; versions persist independently of residency.
result.assumptions: Events are valid under the stated contract, keys are strings, and JSON values are safe finite data. Unknown event types are treated as no-ops.
